decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Existing ground, first and second floor plans SD1846(P)02- A, Existing ground, first and second floor plans SD1846(P) 01, Proposed First Floor, second and roof floor plans SD1846(P)03, untitled Location plan, Proposed first, second and roof floor plans SD1846(P)04) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension with hip to gable conversion, juliette balcony and three roof windows to front elevation
